risk.rationale: Public compatibility schema, semantic classifier, cross-repository impact meaning, ontology-facing identity, and protected fixture/oracle

required_before_red: Approved and Implemented S5 incremental snapshot comparison
Approved and Implemented S6 deterministic provider/client federation
Approved Rust direct JSON-map provider capability
Approved Kotlin/KMP direct JSON-access client capability
prerequisites.unapproved_or_missing_prerequisite: The S7 implementation issue is human-required until every listed prerequisite exists on main.

expected_red.precondition: Every prerequisite is merged and the test harness is added before production implementation.
expected_red.expected_failure: The provider contract and deterministic client links are available, but the implementation-aware capability returns unsupported and emits no SemanticCompatibilityReportV1 finding.
rejected_failures: network, build, target, plugin, or model execution
comparison of only the two byte-identical OpenAPI files
expected_red.reason_not_run: S5, S6, and approved source capability profiles do not yet exist; governance may not fabricate a behavioral Red.

required_separations: presence from declared or applied default
static universal claim from one test or runtime observation
deterministic federation from candidate or conflicting identity
affected client from merely reachable or name-similar client

determinism.set_like_id_lists: UTF-8 byte ascending with duplicates rejected
determinism.replay: 50 sequential replays plus 10 shuffled parallel repetitions are byte-identical

tests.oracle: The expected report validates against the closed Draft 2020-12 schema and rejects missing, unknown, duplicate, unsorted, dangling, or incompatible fields.
Presence, nullability, declared default, and applied default cannot substitute for one another in rule predicates.
The report reconciles contract, provider source, and linked client source without executing any target and exposes exact evidence or explicit gaps.
The strict client is potentially breaking before the provider change because it requires a response field the contract declares optional.
The safe linked client remains compatible and the name-similar client for another operation is rejected.
Byte-identical OpenAPI inputs do not suppress the guaranteed-present to may-be-absent implementation delta.
Insufficient or candidate-only facts produce unresolved with a gap; complete facts select the highest-priority deterministic rule.
Build, target, plugin, network, and model sentinels remain untouched during static analysis.

forbidden: existing accepted contract bundles or goldens
automatic promotion of type names, heuristic links, model output, or missing traces into behavioral facts
claim of arbitrary behavioral equivalence or full causal impact
stop_conditions: contract, provider, and client semantics cannot remain separate
directionality, nullability, default, evidence, rule precedence, or classification is ambiguous
the fixture requires build, target, network, plugin, or model execution
a broad language or framework promise is required without an approved capability matrix
implementation, dependency, policy, workflow, architecture, existing bundle, or release changes become necessary
the task exceeds the allowed paths or high-risk classification
